Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact configured frontend origin. Required for every mutation, including login. Reject missing, null, opaque, or unlisted origins.

Error.description: Typed error; request ID without secrets or stack trace. 409 operation_in_progress includes Retry-After and stable resource ID in details.

Retry-After.description: Required for 409 operation_in_progress; bounded seconds until explicit read/retry guidance, never automatic mutation replay.

Timestamp.description: UTC, second precision; reject impossible dates.

ScopeAuthority.description: Canonical scope hash input. A scope record is not evidence of external permission. Exclusions win; aliases are exact and bound to the dedicated IPv4 asset.

ScopeInput.description: Live scope is one exact IPv4 and explicit TCP ports. Server verifies registered authorization references; client text never grants execution.

MessageCreate.description: Append-only analyst message. All analyst appends increment state_revision conservatively. No inference, approval or execution occurs.

NmapParameters.description: Only bounded TCP connect/light service detection profile parameters. No CLI, NSE, OS detection, UDP or DNS options.

ZapParameters.description: AF-only traditional baseline; origin-wide authorization and matching HTTP service evidence required. Launcher owns flags and loopback port 8090; no legacy fallback.

ActionAuthority.description: Server-derived immutable approval hash input. This DTO is not accepted from a client as execution authority.

PlanCreate.description: Explicit synchronous bounded inference/proposal request. Retry is new intent with a new key, linked to prior identity; execution_unknown requires reconciliation, never a blind rescan.

CancelAccepted.description: Requested cancellation is not proof that the process stopped.

StatusUrl.description: Same-origin domain resource GET URL. No generic job route or arbitrary upstream. IDs and resource kind must match the accepted operation.

file.description: Original bytes, maximum 20 MiB (20971520 bytes), enforced while streaming before parse.

ImportCreate.description: Multipart bytes only; no client filesystem path or URL. Retain original bytes before parser validation. Provenance is a declared input, never evidence of independent verification.

FindingReview.description: Changes analyst disposition only; never promotes technical validation to confirmed.

ReportSnapshot.description: Immutable consistent snapshot covering PDF sections 7.1–7.6. Rendering uses only this snapshot and authorized referenced artifacts, with no remote resource loading. Rejected findings remain in counts/audit/appendix. Snapshot <=10 MiB; rendering <=30 seconds and 512 MiB.

Capabilities.description: Planned means In development and disabled; runtime unavailable is an error. All current service capabilities are planned. Schemas do not enable a service.

WorkspaceSummary.description: Complete authorized totals from one consistent server read; never counts from a partial client page. Failed execution total counts only latest attempt per action.

AuditEventInput.description: Trusted actor/clock injected by infrastructure; caller transaction owns domain mutation plus audit append.

ArtifactInput.description: put_bytes takes bytes, never a client-selected path. Storage computes hash/size and server locator; publication gaps require reconciliation.

ParsedObservation.description: Native parser emits no canonical UUID. Persistence allocates IDs and binds assessment/artifact after validating SourceMetadata.

ParsedBatch.description: parse(raw_bytes, source_metadata), no network/DB. Max depth 64, 10000 records and isolated process wall budget 10 seconds. No fabricated empty success.

AssessmentSnapshot.description: Assessment service consistent authorized read; 10 MiB bound for report/context consumer projection. Model context limits remain separate.

DispatchPermit.description: Reservation only, not start authority. authorize_dispatch locks assessment, action, approval/grant, budget and attempt in that order; one transaction persists reservation/intent/audit. No transaction spans scanner IO.

StartAuthorizationRequest.description: Trusted launcher-only restricted DB function; actor/generation loaded from authenticated service context. No public HTTP endpoint.

StartAuthorization.description: authorize_start serializes on same assessment row after network preparation; validates generation, scope/grant/hash, expiry, cancellation/capability/budget, consumes bound grant once and audits. Logical authorization is not atomic physical start; revocation can race initial traffic.

LauncherSubmit.description: Worker authenticated Unix peer identity plus current claimed attempt; descriptor loaded by restricted launcher DB role. No paths, image, mount, network, argv or shell input.

LauncherStatus.description: Reconcile exact attempt/fence/generation/process/receipt before retry. Unknown scan state forbids blind rescan. Import/render retries reconcile immutable inputs independently.

AssessmentPage.description: Stable opaque cursor ordered by created_at/id (timeline uses at/id; finding priority filter/order is server-owned). Cursors bind actor, assessment, filters, order and read watermark; invalid or changed-query cursor returns 422. Pages are not workspace totals.
